name: Lkyt.
source:
The end of the world is nigh.

The demons that threaten to destroy it inhabit the barren wasteland on the fringe of this world of the living.

There was a group of people who made it their mission to stay in this tainted land and resist the progression of the demons.

These were the people of the land of Migiwa.

In accordance with the law, they strengthen their defenses against the demons and live their days in tranquility.

That hopeless day remained a legend of the distant past, and their return was considered to be one of the distant future.

One night, however, the alarming sound of the emergency bells resounded through the capital.

Why?

Why was it happening now?

In a battle that holds the fate of the world in its hands, our young hero finds the answer to this question…

[Summary translated from official site by [url=https://bljouhou.wordpress.com/games/lkyt/]☆BL News☆[/url]]
translation:
世界末日即将来临。

威胁要摧毁它的恶魔居住在这个生者世界边缘的贫瘠荒地上。

有一群人，以留在这片污浊的土地上，抵抗恶魔的蔓延为己任。

他们是米吉瓦土地上的人民。

他们按照法律，加强对恶魔的防御，过着平静的日子。

那个绝望的日子仍然是遥远过去的传说，而他们的回归被认为是遥远的未来之一。

然而一天晚上，惊心动魄的紧急钟声响彻京城。

为什么？

为什么现在才发生呢？

在一场掌握世界命运的战斗中，我们年轻的英雄找到了这个问题的答案……
